judged_text: Team-member variant of organizer email sends mismatched organizer-personalized content without teamMember prop, and replyTo includes all attendees leaking emails

record.issue_text: Team-member variant of organizer email sends mismatched organizer-personalized content without teamMember prop, and replyTo includes all attendees leaking emails

adjudication.rationale: In `packages/emails/templates/organizer-add-guests-email.ts`, the email payload always renders the template with `attendee: this.calEvent.organizer` (not `this.teamMember`), even though `to` may be a team member via `this.teamMember?.email`, causing team-member recipients to receive organizer-personalized content. Additionally, `replyTo` is set to `[this.calEvent.organizer.email, ...this.calEvent.attendees.map(({ email }) => email)]`, which exposes all attendee emails to the organizer/team-member recipient (privacy leak).
